name: description
label: Description
default: Most leadership teams do not disagree loudly. They agree on the surface and define things differently underneath. MDCompass makes the difference visible.

children.name: text
children.label: text
children.default:
When perspectives genuinely agree

True alignment is when leaders share not just a position but the same definition, the same rationale, and the same operational implication. It is the foundation on which execution is possible.
